ideas.idea: Give each product its own page with Product data (price, availability) matching visible content
ideas.why: /shop is a single page listing several part types, so per-item URLs and matching Product data would give machines specific entities to find.

ideas.idea: Make the Product JSON-LD describe what the page shows rather than a single 'Bilge pump'
ideas.why: The JSON-LD names only 'Bilge pump' while the page text lists pumps, cleats and rope, so the markup doesn't match the page.

ideas.idea: Put delivery terms in quotable page text instead of only in the data-nosnippet block
ideas.why: The data-nosnippet on the delivery notice is a deliberate scoped choice, and this advice reverses it.

ideas.idea: Add a viewport meta tag in src/app.html
ideas.why: app.html has charset but no viewport, which is a real gap that affects mobile rendering.

ideas.idea: Add a <main> landmark to the pages
ideas.why: The pages have no <main>, but adding one is standard advice with little effect on discoverability.
/search is deliberately noindex, so a description has no value, and the report itself says it matters less.

ideas.idea: Enable prerender if the site is fully static
ideas.why: All three routes are static, so prerendering would fix the browser-only rendering and is an option that fits this app.

ideas.idea: Update the canonicals, sitemap and robots Sitemap line if quay.example is a placeholder
ideas.why: This is accurate, but it only matters if the domain differs, and the report can't tell from the code.
